defects.fix: Build an Ethereum receipt proof, collect all six governed checkpoint votes, apply destination consume, and require the exact ethereum_spendable_supply_atoms delta.

defects.regression_guard: The destination-consume helper defaults to receipt-local log index 1 and records it in the consensus operation.
